ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A student sets up a lab experiment to study the behavior of slugs. She sets up a large tray filled with soil that measures 1 square meter and has four sets of conditions, one in each quadrant:

She places 20 slugs in the tray, 5 in each quadrant. Use this information to answer the following questions:
After 20 minutes, 20 slugs are in the high-temperature, low-salinity quadrant. What kind of animal behavior has this experiment displayed?

method.method_draft: Read the setup: slugs are initially distributed equally among four environmental conditions. From the image/text, identify the final condition where all slugs accumulate: high temperature and low salinity. Since the behavior is a movement response to environmental stimuli such as temperature and salinity, classify it using the definition of kinesis: organisms alter movement/activity in response to stimulus intensity and end up concentrated in preferred conditions. Answer: kinesis.

It is not migration because the movement occurs only within a small tray. Aggregation due to changes in activity in response to temperature and salinity conditions is kinesis.
